Parking Lots

Professional Smart Parking Solution for Seamless Vehicle Flow and Safe Management

Coloron/Solutions/Solutions by Scenario/Solutions for Parking Lots

Solution overview

Parking lots of modern commercial buildings, shopping plazas, hospitals, and transit hubs require an efficient, frictionless, and automated management system. As driver volume increases and manual ticket kiosks cause bottleneck delays, Coloron provides an AI-powered end-to-end parking management system covering ANPR entry access, multi-space indoor guidance, flexible automated fee rules, and centralized operational analytics.

2

Entrance & Exit ANPR Speed Barriers

High-speed brushless barrier gates (<1.5s) combined with Deep Learning ANPR capture cameras for ticketless, frictionless vehicle throughput.

Entrance & exit management

Automate lane access and speed up throughput with AI DeepinView ANPR cameras and high-speed boom barriers.

Challenges

Rush hour congestion

Manual paper ticketing and coin payment dispensers cause long queues at entry barriers, leading to severe traffic backlogs that spill onto adjacent public roadways during morning and evening rush hours.

Difficult record retrieval

Without automated license plate identification, verifying lost paper parking slips requires security guards to spend dozens of minutes manually cross-checking paper log books or scrolling through hours of raw CCTV clips.

What we offer

Coloron's intelligent vehicle access control system provides ticketless entry, 99.5%+ plate recognition, and instant whitelist gate opening.

Benefits

  • •Improve traffic efficiency with smooth passing through experience
  • •Enhanced security by authentication and video record
  • •Manage temporary vehicles effectively with manual adjustment

Features

  • •Support vehicle authentication, blocklist alarm, and passing vehicle monitoring
  • •Manual license correction and barrier control
  • •Call remote center for no-toll-booth scenario or when the booth is off-duty
  • •Support statistics of operation data

Indoor parking guidance

Direct drivers quickly to vacant parking spots and assist them in locating their parked cars with smart bay cameras and wayfinding screens.

Challenges

Difficult finding available parking spaces

Drivers wander aimlessly through multi-level subterranean basements searching for vacant bays, resulting in high fuel consumption, carbon monoxide buildup, and immense customer frustration.

Forget where vehicle is parked

In massive malls with thousands of identical parking stalls, shoppers frequently forget their parking section or floor, tying up mall security staff to help hunt down missing cars.

Guidance Benefits & Technology

  • Multi-space bay detection: Dual-lens cameras detect up to 6 spaces simultaneously with built-in RGB indicator lights
  • Color-coded bay indicators: Green (vacant), Red (occupied), Blue (handicapped/reserved), Yellow (EV charging)
  • Electronic aisle signage: Directional dynamic arrows guide motorists at every intersection to rows with vacant stalls
  • "Find My Car" kiosks: Shoppers input their license plate on lobby touchscreen kiosks to see exact parking slot & walking map

Parking fee rules

Establish customizable charging tiers, streamline cashless digital payment, and eliminate cashier revenue leakage.

Challenges

Rush hour processing efficiency

Collecting paper bills and handing back cash coins at exit booths takes 30-45 seconds per car, stalling the entire line when thousands leave concurrently after events.

Wrongful charges and attempted fraud

Manipulated timestamps on paper tickets and unauthorized cashier discounts cause considerable loss of parking proceeds for commercial property managers.

Fee Management Capabilities

  • Flexible fee rule engine: Configure hourly rates, free grace periods, weekend surcharges, and tenant passes
  • Multiple payment avenues: QR code scanning on pillar posters, lobby self-service kiosks, or contactless tap-to-pay
  • Automatic pre-payment validation: Drivers pay in the elevator lobby and exit freely within a 15-minute grace window
  • Complete audit trail: Every rupee collected is cryptographically paired with license plate entry/exit snapshots

Operation & management

Unified command software with real-time lane status, visual occupancy analytics, and cross-subsystem event linking.

Challenges

Lack of video evidence for disputes

Vehicle scratches, hit-and-runs, and barrier contact allegations cannot be resolved without high-resolution video linked directly to the entry gate passage record.

Weak operation without statistics

Property managers lack accurate data on peak parking hours, turnover rates, or revenue discrepancies, making it impossible to optimize bay allocation or dynamic pricing.

Central Platform Benefits

  • Single-pane-of-glass software: View real-time lane barrier status, live camera streams, and revenue logs
  • Visual occupancy heatmaps: Monitor parking bay utilization across all basement levels in real time
  • Automated business reports: Generate daily, monthly, and annual financial statements with one click
  • Remote lane override: Control barrier arms, intercom audio, and manual license approvals from the central SOC
